Hyperliquid trade history, as a journal

Connect HyperliquidSee the journal

Connect in one step

  1. Copy your Hyperliquid wallet address (it starts with 0x).
  2. Paste it into MarginPad Journal and press Connect.
  3. That is all - there is no key. Hyperliquid publishes every account's fills, so the journal reads them like anyone could, and can never place an order.

What you get from your Hyperliquid account

Every trade, rebuiltPartial closes, flips and averaging-in resolved into positions with entry, exit, size and time held.
Fees and funding in dollarsWhat each trade paid at 0.045% taker / 0.015% maker base rates - or your own tier - and what funding took.
Checked against HyperliquidHyperliquid reports a closed P&L on every fill; the journal rebuilds each position from the fills and checks the two against each other.
Where you loseBy market, side, hour, time held and size, with a tilt detector for trades opened right after a loss.
What it would cost elsewhereYour volume and taker share priced on each exchange, against what you actually paid.
Share a verified tradePost a closed trade to the MarginPad chat as a card in Hyperliquid's colours, marked verified from the exchange.

Questions

Do I need an API key?

No. A wallet address is enough, because Hyperliquid fills are public. Nothing is signed and nothing can be traded.

Can someone see my trades?

Anyone with your address can read them on Hyperliquid itself; the journal shows them only to you, in your account.

Does it handle positions opened before the history starts?

Yes. A position that was already open is marked "before history" and takes Hyperliquid's own P&L instead of guessing an entry.

What does it cost?

Nothing. No card and no trial that ends.
